description: Add Pi-Hole blocked query logging. New table pihole_blocked_queries records every blocked DNS lookup with client IP, MAC address (captured at poll time), device, and user attribution. The dns-parser service polls the Pi-Hole v6 API every 30 seconds and writes results. Admin page at /admin/pihole/blocked-queries.

add.description: How often (seconds) dns-parser polls Pi-Hole for blocked queries. Default 30.

notes: Rebuild and restart the dns-parser container to pick up PIHOLE_BASE_URL, PIHOLE_WEBPASSWORD, and PIHOLE_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS env vars. PIHOLE_WEBPASSWORD must already be set in .env (added in manifest 3a81dfd). No new env vars are strictly required — the feature is silently disabled if PIHOLE_WEBPASSWORD is empty.
